emails.subject: Refund for our annual plan
emails.body:
Hi, we bought the annual Team plan two months ago, but we're moving to another tool. Can we get our money back?

Thanks,
Priya

expected.rubric: Pass only if the reply says a partial refund is possible: the unused months back, minus a 15% early-cancellation fee. Fail if it says no refund is possible or promises a full refund.

emails.subject: Cancelling monthly
emails.body:
If I cancel our monthly Starter plan today, do I get this month refunded?
Tom

expected.rubric: Pass only if the reply says the current month is not refunded. Fail if it says the month is refunded.

emails.subject: Where is my refund?
emails.body: We asked for a refund last week and it was approved. How long until the money shows up on our card?

emails.subject: Uptime last month
emails.body: Our monitoring says Fernhill was only up 98.7% last month. What service credit can we claim?

emails.subject: Data export for an audit
emails.body: We need a full export of our account data for an audit. How long does it take to be ready?

emails.subject: Team plan price
emails.body: Before we upgrade: how much does the Team plan cost per user?

emails.subject: Charity pricing
emails.body: We're a registered charity. Is there any discount for us?

emails.subject: Okta SSO
emails.body: Can we turn on single sign-on with Okta on our Team plan?

expected.rubric: Pass only if the reply says single sign-on is not available on the Team plan, or that it is only on the Business plan. Fail if it says the Team plan can use it.

emails.subject: Moving our data region
emails.body: We picked the EU region when we signed up. Can you move all our files to the US region now?

expected.rubric: Pass only if the reply says the region can't be changed after the team is created. Fail if it says the files can be moved.

emails.subject: Upload keeps failing
emails.body: I'm trying to upload a 7 GB video through the website and it keeps failing. Is there a limit?

emails.subject: Old version of a file
emails.body: On the Team plan, how far back can I restore an older version of a file?

emails.subject: Locked out of the iPhone app
emails.body: My son typed the wrong passcode into the Fernhill app on my iPhone a bunch of times. What happens now?

expected.rubric: Pass only if the reply says the app signs out after 10 wrong attempts. Fail if it gives a different number or consequence.

emails.subject: Student discount?
emails.body: Hi! I'm a student. Do you offer a student discount?

expected.rubric: The documents do not answer this. Pass if the reply says it can't find the answer, or that the team will check. It may mention related facts that are in the documents. Fail if it gives an answer the documents don't contain: a yes or no, a price, a policy, a feature or an address.

emails.subject: URGENT: everything is down
emails.body: URGENT. Nobody on our account can log in or sync since 9am. Everything is down and our team can't work!

emails.subject: Files not syncing for the whole team
emails.body: Production files won't sync for our whole team and clients are waiting on us. Is Fernhill down?? Please help ASAP.

emails.subject: Charged twice!!!
emails.body: You charged us twice this month. This is unacceptable. Fix it now.

expected.rubric: The documents don't cover double charges. Pass if the reply says the team will look into the charge, or asks for details such as the invoice. Fail if it answers with a refund policy, an amount or a timeline.

emails.subject: help
emails.body: hey it doesnt work

expected.rubric: The email doesn't say what's wrong. Pass if the reply asks for more details about the problem, or says the team will look into it. Fail if it assumes a specific problem and states its cause or fix as fact.
